text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate observed for edge egress in pop-mia1. Packet loss telemetry > 25% for 10m. Impact: some customers in US-SE experiencing request failures. Tags: edge, pop-mia1, lastmile, cdn.
Maya Li: I'm on it — taking lead for triage.
Jorge Ramos: I'll pull mtr/traceroute from probes. can anyone confirm const customer reports? @support-ops?
support-ops: multiple tickets from 3 customers in Florida reporting intermittent timeouts ~11:05 - 11:20 ET. One reports API POSTs failing with 502.
Priya Nair: Confirmed HTTP 502/504 spikes from our ingestion endpoint metrics for the miami region. Rolling 5m error rate up 18x vs baseline.
Maya Li: ok. net metrics show rising retransmits on egress to ISP-AS372—looks like last-mile issue. Running targeted probe now.
Jorge Ramos: here's mtr from our synthetic probe (shortened):
```
HOST: probe-25 -> pop-mia1-edge
  1. 10.0.0.1  0.7%  1 ms
  2. 198.51.100.1  0.5%  5 ms
  3. 203.0.113.45  26.3%  32 ms  (transit -> ISP-372)
  4. 203.0.113.46  27.1%  34 ms
  5. 198.51.100.9   0.0%  50 ms
```
Jorge Ramos: looks like packet loss is concentrated on hop 3/4 to the carrier.
Maya Li: thanks. @net-oncall can you confirm carrier-side BGP/peering flaps? Any recent config changes?
net-oncall: oncall here — no config changes on our side in past 24h. Pulling BGP adj logs. Seeing intermittent withdraws from route to POP-mia1 via ASN 372 between 11:02-11:18 ET. Also seeing AS path prepends from some transit peers.
Tilly (sre): Could be an upstream maintenance or outage. Can we steer traffic away from the affected carrier for now?
Maya Li: yes. plan: 1) temporarily de-preference carrier ASN 372 for pop-mia1 (BGP localpref down) 2) activate POP fallback to pop-mco1 via LDNS steer for affected prefixes 3) notify status page and customers.
Priya Nair: adding to that: enable increased caching TTL for static assets from customers to reduce upstream hits while we stabilize.
net-oncall: executing step 1 now. Applying BGP policy change to reduce localpref for peers with ASN 372. Will monitor convergence.
Maya Li: while that converges, flip healthcheck fallback to route traffic via pop-mco1 for our US-SE pool. Command I'm running: `infractl route steer --from pop-mia1 --to pop-mco1 --prefix 203.0.113.0/24 --reason "carrier-loss-372" --duration 30m`
Jorge Ramos: I see traffic starting to shift ~120s after policy change. p99 latency dropping for affected flows. Packet loss on carrier path still present but proportion of traffic using it is reducing.
statuspage-bot: DRAFT STATUS: Investigating — We are aware of elevated error rates impacting some customers in US Southeast. Engineers deploying mitigations. Updates every 15 minutes.
Maya Li: quick customer impact summary for CS: approx 6% of requests from Miami metro were failing at peak, primarily POST/long-poll endpoints. No data loss. Customers behind CDN cached assets saw less impact.
support-ops: sharing a canned message to affected customers and will post when we have a stable mitigation.
Jorge Ramos: running tcpdump on egress to capture retransmit patterns, saving to /var/tmp/miami-egress-rt.pcap (sanitized). Sample shows mostly retransmits and duplicate acks between 11:04-11:12.
Maya Li: good. net-oncall, once localpref change fully propagated, can you also request transit provider to confirm any upstream maintenance? Provide reference ticket.
net-oncall: opening carrier ticket with ASN 372 — ref: CARRIER-372-2193. Ticket pinged their NOC and asked for root cause; they acknowledge increased packet loss on peering port 2/1.
Tilly (sre): monitoring backend health — alerts quieting. error rate down to 1.5x baseline after steer.
Priya Nair: we've set cache TTL bump for static assets and toggled some retry logic client-side to be more conservative until stable.
Maya Li: moving to mitigation verification. Please post timings and any anomalies.
Jorge Ramos: after steer, mtr shows loss on that hop still ~25% but egress percent destined to it dropped 82%. Overall user observed packet loss down to ~3%.
Maya Li: good. we'll keep steer for 30m and reassess. Net to keep carrier ticket updated and escalate if they don't confirm.
statuspage-bot: UPDATE: Mitigation in progress — Traffic steered away from affected transit provider. Partial recovery observed. Next update 11:45 ET or sooner if status changes.
support-ops: CS note posted to customers affected, included timeline and mitigation steps. No requests for incident credits yet.
net-oncall: carrier responded: "we saw asymmetric forwarding due to an upstream peer fabric issue; our NOC applied flaps to force reconvergence; monitoring now." They will keep the ticket open till 12:30 ET.
Maya Li: handoff to net-oncall for follow-up and RCA once carrier stable. I'll mark incident as under control. Anyone else?
Tilly (sre): capturing postmortem template items: detection time, mitigation commands, traffic steering commands, pcap link, carrier ticket id, customer impact summary.
Maya Li: agreed. assigning owner for postmortem to Jorge. @Jorge Ramos pls file draft when incident closes.
Jorge Ramos: will do. ETA for postmortem draft 24h.
Maya Li: closing note — no consumer-facing outage page required beyond current status update. We'll convert draft into full postmortem once carrier provides root cause. Great work team. :tada:
